label: Repeated Roots
subgoals: A polynomial is separable when it has no repeated root in an algebraic closure.
Equivalently, it is coprime with its formal derivative.

label: Characteristic Zero and Characteristic p
subgoals: Over a field of characteristic zero every irreducible polynomial is separable.
In characteristic p the derivative of x to the p minus a is zero.

label: Finite Fields
subgoals: Every finite extension of a finite field is separable because the Frobenius map is bijective.
The derivative test remains the quickest computational check.
